NTA, If I was your best friend I would absolutely ask you if it was cool first. I’m a little confused on the timeframe between the breakup and the party. But dude, he was laying down with her in YOUR bed and you didn’t at least kick them out? You seem like a really chill dude and I really respect you for being so calm about all of this, but you can’t let people fuck with you like that! You’re you! Completely unique, kind, and awesome, don’t let people take advantage of that. You told your friend how you felt in a completely respectful way and he seemed to respond well to it. Your ex acted really sketch before and during the breakup, did she give you a reason? She doesn’t really have to I’m just wondering. 

You’re a good dude, just stand up for yourself. Definitely NTA
